## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle systematic catalogue of *dhāraṇīs* organised by **family** (*bù* 部 = the five Esoteric families: Buddha, Vajra, Lotus, Jewel, Karma) by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)). The text is a working reference for the Esoteric *ācāryā* who needed to find *dhāraṇīs* by deity-family-affiliation.

**Abstract**

The *Dōubù tuóluóní mù* organises the principal *dhāraṇīs* of the Tang Esoteric corpus by family — Buddha-family (with Mahāvairocana and the cosmic Buddhas), Vajra-family (with Vajrapāṇi and the Vajra-bodhisattvas), Lotus-family (with Avalokiteśvara and the Lotus deities), Jewel-family (with the Ratna-deities), and Karma-family (with the Karma deities). For each family, the text gives a sequential listing of the principal *dhāraṇīs* with brief identifying notes.

The text is one of Amoghavajra's working scholarly reference compositions; together with [KR6j0073](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0073) (the theoretical *Zǒngshì tuóluóní yì zàn*), it gives the Tang Esoteric tradition's twin theoretical-and-practical framework for *dhāraṇī* practice.

The composition dates from Amoghavajra's mature Chángān period (746–774).
